Subject: [patch@32376] VMS symbolic links part 4 of 4 - Final part

Final installment for implementing symbolic links in Perl on VMS.

In vms.c expose vms_realpath() and vms_realname() routines to return the 
real path of a file in VMS::Filespec

In vmsish.h, support for vms_realname()

In ext/vms/Filespec.pm update the POD documentation.

In cwd.pm, detect when the vms_realpath and vms_realname are available 
and use them to return the true name of a file for abs_path.  Make sure 
that a VMS directory path is returned in a directory format.

In cwd.t:

A symbolic link needs to be created in Unix format to be valid on VMS.
Revert $want to be what the test used to be with one change, remove 
leading '[' on VMS from $want for directory comparison.

Make comparison regex case insensitive.

I know this is late, but can we try to get this in 5.10 for completeness?

-John
